tools.name: get_my_account
tools.title: Get my account
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's profile (name, email, phone) and assigned roles.

tools.name: list_my_licenses
tools.title: List my licenses
tools.description: List the signed-in user's extension licenses with status, type, activation and expiry dates. Never returns the license secret, only the last 4 characters.

status.description: Optional status filter, e.g. active, expired, revoked.

limit.description: Maximum number of licenses to return (default 20).

tools.name: get_my_token_balance
tools.title: Get my token balance
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's token allowances (total, used, remaining, period end) and any active trial.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.title: List plans
tools.description: List the active plans sold by this app, with price, duration, device limits and highlights.
